object_description: large free-form pavilion volume beneath a striking wooden roof
design_condition: The free-form building is placed at the edge of the park and shaped by the terrain, creating a representative entrance square but compressing the space around the outdoor pool and leaving residual green areas.

positive.statement: The rounded overall shape and independent expression create identity and stand out from the neighbouring structures.
The representative entrance square provides good addressing and enters into dialogue with the neighbourhood.
The delicate wooden facade and surrounding canopy create an inviting external appearance.
Exciting connections emerge between inside and outside.
The indoor pool is attractively designed and coherently organized on one floor.
Operation and separation of processes are guaranteed in the ice-rink cloakroom area.
The building is carefully embedded into the terrain, ensuring a small excavation volume.
The materialization is resource-saving and carefully worked out.
The compact arrangement makes the project one of the cheaper shortlisted proposals.

negative.statement: The scale of the new building is excessive for the small park.
The building sits on the edge rather than in the park, while the narrow gap pressures the outdoor pool.
The parking situation along the street appears less inviting.
The gridded wooden construction leaves implementation questions and appears arbitrary in relation to the free form.
The transitions from the construction to the facade are uncontrolled.
The cloakroom area is dominated by long, unattractive dark corridors.
Additional paths create striking topographical cuts that do not sufficiently respect the historical concept.
The high degree of sealing conflicts with the landscape intentions.
The staged approach is not convincing.
The impressive spans cause unnecessary structural effort.
The large glazed areas may produce difficult-to-control temperature curves.
The project is too space-intensive and ultimately weakens the identity of the outdoor pool.
